entities.name: Umezawa's Jitte
entities.description: A legendary jitte, a small-bladed weapon, originally wielded by Toshiro Umezawa throughout his life.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A famous samurai of the Kami War on Kamigawa, transported to Dominaria by the Myojin of Night's Reach, who later founded Clan Umezawa.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War of Kamigawa during which Toshiro Umezawa was a famous samurai.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A myojin that transported Toshiro Umezawa to Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane to which Toshiro was transported.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: Object that contained the Jitte or a very similar Lost Jitte.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane where the Lost Jitte was later released.
